mapper.select: SELECT member_idx AS memberIdx, member_id, member_pwd, member_name, member_email, member_phone, member_level FROM tb_member

SELECT member_idx AS memberIdx, member_id AS memberId, member_pwd AS memberPwd, member_name AS memberName, member_email AS memberEmail, member_phone AS memberPhone, member_level AS memberLevel FROM tb_member WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT room_idx AS accNo, room_name AS accName, room_size AS accLocation, room_price_weekdays AS accPrice FROM tb_room

SELECT r.rv_code AS resNo, m.member_id AS memberId, m.member_name AS resName, ro.room_name AS accName, r.rv_start_date AS checkIn, r.rv_end_date AS checkOut, r.rv_status AS resStatus FROM tb_reservation r JOIN tb_member m ON r.rv_member_idx = m.member_idx JOIN tb_room ro ON r.rv_room_idx = ro.room_idx

SELECT b.board_idx AS id, b.board_title AS title, b.board_create_idx AS writer, b.board_create_date AS createdAt, MAX(r.reply_contents) AS answer, ( CASE WHEN COUNT(r.reply_idx) > 0 THEN '답변완료' ELSE '미답변' END ) AS answerStatus FROM tb_board b LEFT JOIN tb_reply r ON b.board_idx = r.reply_board_idx GROUP BY b.board_idx, b.board_title, b.board_create_idx, b.board_create_date ORDER BY b.board_idx DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_reply (reply_contents, reply_board_idx, reply_create_idx) VALUES (#{answer}, #{id}, #{writer})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_reply SET reply_contents = #{answer}, reply_create_date = NOW() WHERE reply_board_idx = #{id}
